register.name: AIRCR
register.description: Application Interrupt and Reset Control Register

bit_field.name: VECTCLRACTIVE
bit_field.description: Reserved for Debug use. This bit reads as 0. When writing to the register you must write 0 to this bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE. This bit is not banked between Security states.

bit_field.name: SYSRESETREQ
bit_field.description: System reset request. This bit allows software or a debugger to request a system reset. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW if SYSRESETREQS is 0. When SYSRESETREQS is set to 1, from Non-secure state this bit acts as RAZ/WI.

bit_field_value.name: AIRCR_SYSRESETREQ_NO_REQUEST
bit_field_value.description: Do not request a system reset.

bit_field_value.name: AIRCR_SYSRESETREQ_REQUEST_RESET
bit_field_value.description: Request a system reset.

bit_field.name: SYSRESETREQS
bit_field.description: System reset request, Secure state only. The value of this bit defines whether the SYSRESETREQ bit is functional for Non-secure use. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure State and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

bit_field_value.name: AIRCR_SYSRESETREQS_SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
bit_field_value.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is available to both Security states.

bit_field_value.name: AIRCR_SYSRESETREQS_SECURE_ONLY
bit_field_value.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is only available to Secure state.

bit_field.name: PRIGROUP
bit_field.description: Interrupt priority grouping field. This field determines the split of group priority from subpriority. This bit is banked between Security states

bit_field.name: BFHFNMINS
bit_field.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI Non-secure enable. The value of this bit defines whether BusFault and NMI exceptions are Non-secure, and whether exceptions target the Non-secure HardFault exception. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure-state and RO from Non-secure state.

bit_field_value.name: AIRCR_BFHFNMINS_SECURE
bit_field_value.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI are Secure.

bit_field_value.name: AIRCR_BFHFNMINS_NON_SECURE
bit_field_value.description: BusFault and NMI are Non-secure and exceptions can target Non-secure HardFault.

bit_field.name: PRIS
bit_field.description: Prioritize Secure exceptions. The value of this bit defines whether Secure exception priority boosting is enabled. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure state and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

bit_field_value.name: AIRCR_PRIS_SAME_PRIORITY
bit_field_value.description: Priority ranges of Secure and Non-secure exceptions are identical

bit_field_value.name: AIRCR_PRIS_SECURE_PRIORITIZED
bit_field_value.description: Non-secure exceptions are de-prioritized

bit_field.name: ENDIANNESS
bit_field.description: Data endianness bit. This bit is not banked between Security states.

bit_field.name: VECTKEY
bit_field.description: Register key: Reads as 0xFA05. On writes, write 0x5FA to VECTKEY, otherwise the write is ignored. This Field is not banked between Security states.

register.name: SCR
register.description: The SCR controls features of entry to and exit from low-power state.

bit_field.name: SLEEPONEXIT
bit_field.description: Indicates sleep-on-exit when returning from Handler mode to Thread mode. Setting this bit to 1 enables an interrupt driven application to avoid returning to an empty main application. This bit is banked between Security states.

bit_field_value.name: SCR_SLEEPONEXIT_NOT_SLEEP
bit_field_value.description: Do not sleep when returning to Thread mode.

bit_field_value.name: SCR_SLEEPONEXIT_SLEEP
bit_field_value.description: Enter sleep, or deep sleep, on return from an ISR

bit_field.name: SLEEPDEEP
bit_field.description: Controls whether the processor uses sleep or deep sleep as its low-power mode. This bit is not banked between Security states.

bit_field_value.name: SCR_SLEEPDEEP_DEEP_SLEEP
bit_field_value.description: Deep sleep.

bit_field.name: SLEEPDEEPS
bit_field.description: Controls whether the SLEEPDEEP bit is only accessible from the Secure state. This bit in only accessible from the Secure state, and behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Nonsecure state. This bit is not banked between Security states.

bit_field_value.name: SCR_SLEEPDEEPS_SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
bit_field_value.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit is accessible from both Security states.

bit_field_value.name: SCR_SLEEPDEEPS_SECURE_ONLY
bit_field_value.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Non-secure state.

bit_field.name: SEVONPEND
bit_field.description: Send Event on Pending bit. When an event or interrupt enters pending state, the event signal wakes up the processor from WFE. If the processor is not waiting for an event, the event is registered and affects the next WFE. The processor also wakes up on execution of an SEV instruction or an external event. This bit is banked between Security states.

bit_field_value.name: SCR_SEVONPEND_EXCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
bit_field_value.description: Only enabled interrupts or events can wakeup the processor, disabled interrupts are excluded.

bit_field_value.name: SCR_SEVONPEND_INCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
bit_field_value.description: Enabled events and all interrupts, including disabled interrupts, can wakeup the processor
